title: Authority Tuple
description: Defines the structure for authority tuples that govern who may cause what change under what conditions.

actor.description: The entity (human, Naya, system) that holds this authority

action.description: The specific action this authority permits

scope.description: The boundary within which this authority is valid

granted_by.description: The entity that granted this authority

expires_at.description: When this authority expires, null for non-expiring

constraints.description: Additional constraints on the use of this authority
